Frequently asked questions
What is Klaviyo?
Klaviyo is the autonomous B2C CRM and AI marketing platform that unifies customer data and automates email, SMS, RCS, WhatsApp, and mobile push to drive personalized, revenue-generating campaigns. Built as both a system of record and system of action, Klaviyo combines a customer data platform, real-time signals, and AI agents to power automated insights and one-click execution.
How much does Klaviyo cost? Is there a free plan?
Yes. Klaviyo offers a free plan with core features , and paid plans scale based on the number of contacts and channel usage (such as email and SMS). Enterprise pricing is also available for large organizations with advanced needs.
What integrations does Klaviyo offer?
Klaviyo offers native integrations with ecommerce platforms like Shopify , plus connectors for payment providers, CRMs, analytics tools, and messaging platforms. We also integrate with your favorite AI tools with our Klaviyo ChatGPT app, Klaviyo Claude Connector, and Klaviyo MCP for building agentic workflows. These integrations sync customer, product, and order data in real time to power personalized marketing and automation.
What channels does Klaviyo support?
Klaviyo unifies email , SMS / Text, RCS , mobile push , WhatsApp and web events into a single customer profile so you can run consistent, data-driven omnichannel marketing .
That unified CDP + real-time signals power cross-channel flows, predictive analytics, and agent decisions to deliver more relevant messages where customers prefer to engage.
How does Klaviyo support enterprise brands?
For enterprise brands , Klaviyo is the unified B2C CRM built to replace fragmented legacy stacks — consolidating data, execution, and analytics into one secure, scalable platform. Unlike rigid suites that require constant developer intervention and data syncing, Klaviyo gives marketing teams the autonomy to launch sophisticated omnichannel campaigns across email, SMS, push, WhatsApp, and web in days, not months.
Built on a flexible data foundation with unified customer profiles, 400+ native integrations, and full developer tooling (APIs, webhooks, SDKs, warehouse syncs), Klaviyo deploys rapidly — with enterprise-grade security, audit-ready compliance, dedicated CSMs, and peak-season uptime backed by SLAs.
Which languages is Klaviyo available in?
The Klaviyo platform and Help Center are available in 12 languages: English, French, German, Spanish, Mexican Spanish, Italian, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, Swedish, Polish, Dutch, and Japanese — with each version continuously being updated as new features become available for market.
For step-by-step instructions on how to change language in the Klaviyo Platform visit our Help Center guide .
Is Klaviyo GDPR compliant?
Klaviyo has implemented measures to meet its GDPR obligations as a data processor, including a Data Processing Agreement , comprehensive security measures, and self-service tools to support data subject rights requests.
Klaviyo also supports lawful international data transfers through mechanisms like the EU–US Data Privacy Framework and Standard Contractual Clauses.
GDPR compliance is a shared responsibility: Klaviyo provides the tools, while each business is responsible for how it collects and uses customer data.

Email marketing FAQs
What is Klaviyo email marketing?
Klaviyo email marketing is a platform that helps brands create, send, and automate personalized email campaigns using data-driven AI to reach customers with the right message at the right time.
What ROI can brands expect from Klaviyo email marketing?
Klaviyo delivers an average of 63x ROI, and automated emails drive over 14x higher revenue per recipient compared to manual campaigns.
Does Klaviyo support cross-channel marketing beyond email?
Yes, Klaviyo lets you build flows and campaigns that combine email with SMS and mobile push marketing, all from a single platform.
Can I create emails in Klaviyo without coding?
Yes, Klaviyo offers a drag-and-drop editor, over 160 customizable templates, and AI-generated email content so anyone can build high-converting emails without writing code.
How do I start building an email list with Klaviyo?
Klaviyo offers built-in web forms and over 70 customizable form templates to help you collect new subscribers and gather customer insights directly from your site.
How much does Klaviyo email marketing cost?
Klaviyo pricing starts at $60 per month based on active profiles, and a free tier is available for accounts with under 250 active profiles and 500 monthly email sends.
How can email marketing fuel your overall inbound strategy?
Email marketing fuels your overall inbound strategy by enabling targeted communication with your audience, nurturing leads, driving website traffic, and increasing customer engagement, ultimately resulting in higher conversions and a boosted return on investment (ROI).

Frequently asked questions
How is Klaviyo’s service set up?
Klaviyo’s platform is hosted on AWS cloud infrastructure and is a one-to-many, software-as-a-service solution for customers to manage marketing automation and data. This means you fully control and manage your account on the platform and how you configure campaigns, collect and manage data, and send out messages.
What agreements govern the use of the Klaviyo platform and services?
Customer’s use of the platform is governed by our Terms of Use , which incorporates our Data Processing Agreement , Acceptable Use Policy , Privacy Notice , and API Terms of Use (if applicable).
Where is Klaviyo located and where is my data stored?
Klaviyo is a global company headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts with offices in the US, UK and Australia. The Klaviyo platform and customer data are hosted in AWS data centers located in the US. Klaviyo also uses Sub-processors to assist in providing its services to customers. Information on Sub-processors’ processing locations are described in https://www.klaviyo.com/legal/subprocessors .
Who can I reach out to if I have more questions?
For any additional questions please contact us .
